items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about Henry Allen, the old man, did he play dance jobs too or just brass bands? [INTERVIEWEE] I never saw him play dance. No, no. He never saw him. He never saw him. Just a brass band.

ctx.x: Yeah, once you learned the fingering, you could play it. Yeah, yeah.
I played with Allen. I played with Allen, and I played, uh, in Allen with, uh, me and, uh, Lewis, Lewis Armstrong, Allen, and Three Cornets. Yeah, well, that's in the 20s.
